text.tspan: QKV | one column shard turns into a column-wide multicast
Full geometry: A1 = 128 x 80, A2 = 128 x 256, A3 = 128 x 160. Coordinates below are block-local.
Squares: blue = C8 senders, orange = C9 senders. Arrows track the two example payloads.
A1(c, c mod 80) --EAST--> A2(c, c mod 80) --NORTH + SOUTH--> A2(c, every row)
c=0..79 uses C8; c=80..127 uses C9. Horizontal travel preserves column ownership.
c=0 and c=80 arrive at y=0: SOUTH only. Other receiver rows fan out in both directions.
Rows 0..47 carry two source payloads; rows 48..79 carry one. Offset strokes above share row 47.
Scope starts after A1 computes QKV. A1 reductions / RoPE and A2 attention collectives are separate operations.
Before these arrows: 80 A1 rows contribute partial dot-products per column; Y all-reduce produces replicas.
After QK-norm / RoPE: choose ONE ready replica per column to send. 128 columns = 128 QKV injectors.
The 80 row contributions are summed, not concatenated into 80 payloads. A2 receives one 48-element S[c].
ALL 128 SENDERS | enlarged A1 PE map
One colored square = one sender PE. Other A1 PEs compute/relay, but do not inject the cross-region QKV.
Blue: 80 senders at (c,c), c=0..79. Orange: 48 senders at (c,c-80), c=80..127.
Source rule: local_py == local_px % a1_height. Highlighted coordinates are exact; inset is enlarged.
